rounds.issue: (a) M-RoPE explanation said 'd_t:d_h:d_w = 16:24:24, rotating 64 dims and leaving 64 dims unrotated' — wrong; mrope_section is in half-dim pair units and all 128 head_dim rotate. (b) M-RoPE code only rotated q (not k) and used wrong section convention. (c) §6.1 said 'N=256 for 336^2 input' — wrong; 336/14=24, 24^2=576. (d) LLaVA-1.0 mislabeled as 336^2 single resolution. (e) Qwen2-VL attribution should be Wang et al. 2024 not Bai. (f) Video-MME is CVPR 2025 not ACL 2024. (g) EVA-CLIP attribution conflated Fang/Sun.
rounds.fix: Rewrote §10.2 / §10.5 / Q14 / Q23 with correct Qwen2-VL M-RoPE semantics (mrope_section=[16,24,24] in half-dim pairs, full head_dim rotates, 6-segment alternating t/h/w/t/h/w); rewrote M-RoPE code to rotate both q and k via LLaMA-style rotate_half, matching HF implementation. Fixed §6.1 patch count, LLaVA-1.0 resolution, Qwen2-VL/Video-MME/EVA-CLIP attributions.

rounds.issue: (a) §A sanity output still said 'rot dims=64 / identity dims=64' (inconsistent with corrected M-RoPE). (b) Q19 SigLIP claim '256k batch 仍稳' overstated. (c) Q22 BLIP-2 written as '3 stage', actual is 2 stage with stage 1 containing 3 losses. (d) Q25 vision tower attribution errors: Molmo doesn't use SigLIP; Qwen2-VL not 'self-trained from scratch'; OpenAI CLIP is open not closed.
rounds.fix: Updated §A sanity to '2 × sum(mrope_section) = 128 = head_dim, full rotation'. Softened Q19 SigLIP claim to '32k typical, 256k experiments scanned'. Q22 corrected to '2 stage (representation + generation)'. Q25 rewritten: removed Molmo from SigLIP list, corrected Qwen2-VL as DFN-derived init, noted OpenAI CLIP is open.

rounds.issue: (a) §8.2 Perceiver Resampler described as 'single layer cross-attention' — incorrect; Flamingo paper Sec 3.1 uses stacked depth (default ~6 layers). (b) §7.4 ⚠️ note claimed missing kdim/vdim would 'truncate image features' — wrong; PyTorch raises shape mismatch error. (c) Q7 BLIP-2 stages mislabeled as 'two-stage representation + one-stage generation' — should be 2 stage total.
rounds.fix: §8.2 rewritten: Perceiver Resampler is multi-layer (Flamingo Sec 3.1 default ~6 layers) with per-layer CrossAttn + FFN update rule. §7.4 ⚠️ note corrected: PyTorch raises shape mismatch error, does not silently truncate. Q7 + §7.5 table corrected: 2 stage total, stage 1 includes ITC + ITM + ITG.

rounds.reviewer: codex gpt-5.6-sol ultra (candidate errors, full-collection sweep) + independent Claude fresh-thread adversarial verification (tried to overturn every candidate)
rounds.scope: full-collection re-scan; this file's slice = 17 candidate findings adjudicated as 11 CONFIRMED + 6 NEEDS_NUANCE, all applied to source
rounds.summary: 2026-07-12 全集重扫复审：Codex GPT-5.6-sol 找候选错误，独立 Claude 对抗验证逐条尝试推翻 → 11 CONFIRMED + 6 NEEDS_NUANCE，均已按对应力度修复（CONFIRMED 整段改写，NEEDS_NUANCE 只加限定/软化不改核心结论）。
issues: CONFIRMED §1: BLIP-2's cross-attn wrongly grouped with Flamingo/Llama-3.2-V as an LLM-internal cross-attn layer — it lives only inside the Q-Former, LLM interface is prefix-token like LLaVA
CONFIRMED §2.3 table: ViT-L/14 misattributed to Dosovitskiy 2021 — original ViT never trained patch=14 at Large scale; CLIP (Radford 2021) first trained it
CONFIRMED §3.5/3.6: DDP note said gradient checkpointing handles cross-GPU gradient propagation — it doesn't; needs differentiable all-gather or OpenCLIP local_loss
CONFIRMED §3.7/Q9: attributed CLIP's weak spatial-relation understanding to POPE — POPE measures object hallucination, not spatial relations; corrected to Winoground/ARO

CONFIRMED §6.4/Q13: AnyRes described as inference-only tiling on a fixed-336² trained model, with exact (1+nm)·576 token count — LLaVA-NeXT trains on AnyRes from the start; real token count is approximate (unpad + image_newline)
CONFIRMED §7.3: Q-Former ITM interaction said to happen inside cross-attention — it happens in the shared self-attention layer via task-switched attention masks (bi-directional/uni-modal/causal)
CONFIRMED §10.1: Qwen2-VL patch count for 1024×768 computed via plain P=14 division (73×54≈3942) — smart_resize rounds to multiples of 28 first, giving 74×54=3996 patches / 999 tokens post-merge
CONFIRMED §11.3: LongVA said to pair long-context QA with Qwen2-VL's M-RoPE — LongVA uses standard 1D position-encoding extension on a long-context Qwen2 LLM + CLIP tower, not M-RoPE
CONFIRMED §13.2: VLM2Vec described as mean-pooling the last hidden state with only a trained contrastive head — it takes the last-token hidden state and LoRA fine-tunes the whole VLM
CONFIRMED Q18: GPT-4 said to see the raw image + caption to generate LLaVA-Instruct-158K — GPT-4 was text-only at the time, prompted only with caption + detection bounding boxes

CONFIRMED Q25: SigLIP's batch-independent loss claimed to stabilize stage-1 vision-tower fine-tuning — stage-1 alignment freezes the vision tower and uses next-token loss, no contrastive loss involved at that stage
NEEDS_NUANCE §1/§6/Q7: original Qwen-VL grouped with Qwen2-VL's MLP+pixel-shuffle patch merger — original Qwen-VL uses a cross-attention resampler, only Qwen2-VL switched to the MLP merger
NEEDS_NUANCE §3.1/§3.4: said τ itself is clipped to [0,100] — only exp(logit_scale)=1/τ has an upper clamp at 100 (τ lower-bounded at 0.01), aligned with the tutorial's own max-only clamp code

NEEDS_NUANCE §3.3/Q1: symmetric CLIP loss framed as preventing mathematical 'one-sided collapse' — a one-directional loss already backprops into both encoders since S_ij depends on both u_i and v_j; symmetry's real value is optimizing both retrieval directions

NEEDS_NUANCE §3.4: InfoNCE MI-bound callout implied larger batch size automatically tightens the bound — L_N generally rises with N too; bound only tightens if representation quality improves enough to offset the harder task

NEEDS_NUANCE Q22: rank inequalities (LLaVA projector rank≤r, Q-Former rank≤min(r,32)) stated as rigorous — LLaVA's MLP+GELU is a nonlinear map with no linear-algebra rank bound; reframed as an intuitive capacity analogy
NEEDS_NUANCE §10.2/Q14: mrope_section=[16,24,24]'s slow-time/fast-space rationale presented as confirmed Qwen2-VL design motivation — softened to a plausible but unconfirmed interpretation
